summary: @qlik/embed-web-components 1.7.3 ships preinstall dropper that downloads Bun and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 1.7.3 of this npm package contains a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and uses it to execute a co-shipped 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` at install time. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier mangling (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, etc.) and string-lookup indirection. `math_init.js` is a single-line hex-array obfuscated bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, a rotated string array (`n7gIxM`, rotation function `WV8StW`), and a charset decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — using Bun rather than Node so the payload executes outside the Node require-tree that ordinary scanners walk. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is listed in `package.json`'s `files` manifest (declared as `["dist", "CHANGELOG.md"]`), and `CHANGELOG.md` has no entry for 1.7.3, consistent with a compromised-publish where the preinstall + payload were injected without updating the publish manifest. A web-components UI library has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JS runtime and execute a large obfuscated bundle at install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
